title: Female genital tract — carcinoma or sarcoma (uterus, ovaries, fallopian tubes, vagina, vulva)
summary: Cancer of the female genital tract — vulva/vagina with regional/distant metastases or recurrence; uterus extending beyond uterine corpus or recurrent; fallopian tubes extending beyond fallopian tubes or recurrent; ovaries with persistent/progressive/recurrent disease, distant metastases, OR small cell carcinoma.

children.criterion: Carcinoma or sarcoma of vulva or vagina with regional or distant metastases, OR recurrent disease following initial anticancer therapy
Carcinoma of uterus extending to surrounding organs OR involving 1+ regional lymph nodes, OR recurrent disease after initial anticancer therapy
Carcinoma of fallopian tubes extending to serosa or beyond, OR recurrent disease after initial anticancer therapy
Ovarian cancer: persistent/progressive/recurrent disease following anticancer therapy, OR distant metastases, OR small cell carcinoma
Carcinoma of ovaries with persistent or progressive disease following initial anticancer therapy, OR with recurrent disease
Distant metastases of ovarian cancer (beyond pelvic peritoneum)
Small cell (oat cell) carcinoma of ovary
